scientific.integrity: The same-object regular-Reuleaux full text was materially compared at its all-order area formula, and a direct Reuleaux-triangle polar-moment source was inspected as prior special-case coverage. Searches crossed mechanical and convex-geometric aliases. The new formula is proved by exact sector/triangle moment decomposition and replayed symbolically; numerical integration is supplementary only.
limitations: The result covers regular Reuleaux odd-gons of order at least five; the triangle polar moment is prior-covered.
No extremal statement over irregular Reuleaux polygons is claimed.
An unindexed family inertia computation remains a historical originality risk.
The older 2000 isoperimetric Reuleaux paper was not materially full-text accessible in this run.

title: Polar moment and isotropic constant of regular Reuleaux odd-gons
